verdict.rationale: Omarchy provides a single-command install that sets up a full dev environment (Install > Development menu, default agent harnesses like OpenCode/Claude Code, editor integrations for VSCode/Cursor/Zed/etc., Lazygit) plus community testimony that 'installing software is easy and lightning-fast.' However, evidence doesn't detail exactly what runtimes/languages are bundled by default vs selected via menu, nor confirm a single literal command covers all of this versus menu-driven selection. missing for 10: explicit single-command install evidence (vs menu-driven setup), independent verification of runtime/toolchain completeness, confirmation these are 'ready to use' without further config.
